judged_text: The permission check joins isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && while naming the result isTeamAdminOrOwner, so team admins who are not owners are denied instead of allowed. A team admin (role ADMIN) who is not the booking's organizer or an attendee gets FORBIDDEN when adding guests to their team's bookings — the admin portion of the intended permission matrix (organizer/admin/owner/attendee) is silently dropped; under exclusive membership roles the && can only ever pass for OWNERs.

record.issue_text: [BUG] The permission check joins isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && while naming the result isTeamAdminOrOwner, so team admins who are not owners are denied instead of allowed. A team admin (role ADMIN) who is not the booking's organizer or an attendee gets FORBIDDEN when adding guests to their team's bookings — the admin portion of the intended permission matrix (organizer/admin/owner/attendee) is silently dropped; under exclusive membership roles the && can only ever pass for OWNERs.

adjudication.rationale:
In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the variable `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&`:
```ts
const isTeamAdminOrOwner =
  (await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) &&
  (await isTeamOwner(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0));
```
Despite the name, this requires the user to be *both* admin and owner to pass. The subsequent permission gate:
```ts
if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN;
```
therefore excludes team admins who are not owners (and not organizer/attendee), matching the finding that the intended “admin OR owner” permission is silently dropped.
